definitions.gloss: traditional Japanese umbrella; Japanese paper umbrella
definitions.explanation: A traditional umbrella made with a bamboo frame and Japanese paper (washi), coated with oil for waterproofing. Distinguished from Western-style umbrellas (洋傘).

examples.english: To hold up a Japanese umbrella.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}の{土産|みやげ}に{和傘|わがさ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a Japanese umbrella as a souvenir from Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}い{和傘|わがさ}が{庭|にわ}に{飾|かざ}られていて、とても{風情|ふぜい}がある。
examples.english: Red Japanese umbrellas are displayed in the garden, creating a very elegant atmosphere.

notes:
USAGE:
{和傘|わがさ} contrasts with {洋傘|ようがさ} (Western umbrella). In modern Japan, {和傘|わがさ} are primarily decorative or used in traditional arts, tea ceremonies, and festivals rather than as everyday rain gear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和傘|わがさ}を{差|さ}す (to hold up a Japanese umbrella)
- {和傘|わがさ}を{開|ひら}く (to open a Japanese umbrella)
- {番傘|ばんがさ} (a common type of plain Japanese umbrella)
- {蛇|じゃ}の{目|め}{傘|がさ} (bull's-eye pattern umbrella)
